top_choice_rationale: Sequencing by synthesis is the one proposal where the invention, the quantitative chemistry (reversible 3'-blocked terminator with cleavable fluorophore, measurable cycle efficiency and error rate, clustered single molecules) and the two-person credit fit in one sentence. Its consequences are mature and independently confirmed over fifteen years, and the Cambridge pair is a clean allocation. Next comes the same part with base editing added, then the PROTAC-centred degradation proposals with a defined design principle, then the mixed degrader/base-editing and condensate proposals, with no award last.
